title: The City Had Only 99 Minutes Left | ECHO//30 Ep. 11
description:
The sealed Door traps Kavi, Tara, Mira, and Imran inside a city whose hundred-minute loop has suddenly lost a minute. Tara takes Kavi's phone and receives a warning in her own future voice: rescuing Imran could erase 412 other people.

Instead of choosing for them, Tara broadcasts the truth to the trapped city. Their voluntary decision to listen gives Null's buried voices a shape—and reveals a path to the Archive Core.

scenes.image_prompt: The maintenance train jolts to a stop before the fully sealed black-metal Door; every analog clock inside snaps from 2:16 to 2:15 while Kavi, Tara, Mira and Imran brace in alarm.
scenes.text: The black Door sealed behind them. Then every clock lost another minute. The hundred-minute city now had only ninety-nine.

scenes.image_prompt: Inside the train cabin, Imran points from Kavi's hidden phone to the locked Door mechanism while Tara watches Kavi with wounded suspicion and Mira studies the failing temporal gauges.
scenes.text: Imran said the core was reacting to hidden intentions. Tara looked at Kavi. Secrets were no longer protection; they were fuel.

scenes.image_prompt: Tara calmly takes the normal-sized cracked phone from Kavi's open hand; their red and cyan light separates them emotionally while Imran and Mira remain behind, no struggle or violence.
scenes.text: Tara took the phone. She would return it when Kavi stopped deciding which truths everyone else was allowed to survive.

scenes.image_prompt: The slim phone in Tara's hand emits her own red audio waveform beside abstract symbols of Imran and 412 fading human lights; Kavi hears it too, with no readable generated words or numbers.
scenes.text: A message played in Tara's future voice: If I bring Imran home, four hundred and twelve others disappear.

scenes.image_prompt: In the underground market, Tara connects her red headphones to an old radio microphone and openly addresses gathered trapped residents; Kavi, Mira and Imran stand behind rather than controlling the crowd.
scenes.text: Tara did not hide the warning. She broadcast it to every trapped resident and asked whether they still wanted the Door opened.

scenes.image_prompt: As residents deliberately switch on radios and cassette players, purple memory veins spread across market walls; Mira recognizes the phenomenon while a layered but non-gory Null silhouette forms overhead.
scenes.text: Mira warned that listening would awaken every memory the city had denied. One by one, the residents turned their radios louder.

scenes.image_prompt: Hundreds of purple voice threads leave the listening residents and resolve into one luminous route map through the market floor toward a distant archive tower; Null remains a collective silhouette, not attacking.
scenes.text: Null's chorus stopped screaming. The voices became a map, leading beneath the city toward the Archive Core.

scenes.image_prompt: Tara returns the cracked phone to Kavi without touching his hand; behind them the synchronized market clocks clearly show one minute less and the purple route opens ahead, Imran and Mira ready to move.
scenes.text: Tara returned the phone as evidence, not forgiveness. Above them, the clocks jumped again. Ninety-eight minutes remained.
